## Feature Proposal
A clear and concise description of the feature you are proposing.

## Problem Statement
Is your feature request related to a problem or limitation? Please describe. (e.g. "I'm always frustrated when [...]")

## Proposed Solution
A clear description of what you want to happen and how it enhances the user experience or protocol utility.

## Alternative Solutions
Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, UI mockups, or screenshots about the feature request here.
